testInfo.title: ETS 2026 — Full Test 06
testInfo.description: Đề thi TOEIC L&R chính thức ETS 2026 — Test 6 (200 câu, 120 phút). Đề minh hoạ phục vụ học tập.

options.text: A restaurant buffet is filled with food.
Cups are sitting in a sink.

(A) Quầy buffet của nhà hàng được bày đầy thức ăn.
(B) Các cốc đang đặt trong bồn rửa.
(C) Khu vực ăn uống thì trống trơn.
(D) Một vài cây nến đã được thắp sáng.

(C) Người đàn ông đang lau chùi một cái máy.

questions.text: How long will the renovations take?
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi How long → trả lời thời gian: khoảng một tháng.

questions.text: What is the factory's inspection process like?
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi What...like → mô tả quy trình: khá kỹ lưỡng.

questions.text: Hasn't our merchandise arrived yet?

options.text: No, it was just shipped yesterday.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi Who → Carlos và tôi.

questions.text: Why is the reception at a different location?

Because the conference room wasn't big enough.
Yes, I can hear you very well—thank you.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi Why → vì phòng hội nghị không đủ lớn.

questions.text: Would you like me to process your travel voucher?
questions.explanation: Đề nghị → đồng ý nếu có thời gian.

questions.text: How far away is Azuma's Dry Cleaning Company?

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi How far → vài phút đi bộ.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi Yes/No → đã in xong.

questions.text: I could provide you with a copy of the lease.

options.text: No, I bought it last month.

options.text: She read one of his books.

questions.explanation: Khuôn viên phía trước tòa nhà hội lịch sử → đối chiếu bản đồ.

questions.explanation: Khuyên đi bộ vì nhiều đường bị chặn.

questions.text: On Saturday, the Edbridge Orchestra will ------- a new work by local composer Nina Borstein.
questions.explanation: perform a work = biểu diễn tác phẩm âm nhạc.

questions.text: It is important to be especially ------- when in the company of new clients.
questions.explanation: Sau to be cần tính từ → polite.

questions.text: Although Ms. Endou was not chosen for an award, ------- achievements were praised.
questions.explanation: Tính từ sở hữu trước danh từ achievements → her.

questions.text: At the end of the year, organizations face pressure to achieve their financial -------.
questions.explanation: financial goals = mục tiêu tài chính.

questions.text: Online ordering is ------- on Naito Café's Web site.
questions.explanation: available on a website = có sẵn trên trang web.

questions.text: Mayor Park plans to meet with his campaign staff ------- the televised debate.
questions.explanation: following = sau khi (giới từ chỉ thời gian).

questions.text: Mr. Suh has requested that a more ------- copy machine be purchased for the finance department.
questions.explanation: more + tính từ + danh từ → reliable copy machine.

questions.text: Mr. Aponte's photograph of the autumn foliage will be featured on the front ------- of Outward Expansion Magazine.
questions.explanation: front cover = trang bìa trước.

questions.text: Handi Office Supplies' new desk organizers serve ------- practical and stylish additions to any office workstation.
questions.explanation: serve as = đóng vai trò như.

questions.text: The efficient redesign of the airline terminal led to ------- flight delays.
questions.explanation: fewer + danh từ đếm được số nhiều (delays).

questions.text: Mr. Ogbu's editor appreciated his ability to approach the subject matter -------.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho động từ approach.

questions.text: Mr. Nakayama was named Employee of the Year, ------- being new to the company.
questions.explanation: despite + V-ing = mặc dù.

questions.text: For the ------- selection of premium paints and art-making supplies anywhere, visit your nearest Painters' Best store.
questions.explanation: the + so sánh nhất → widest.

questions.text: The Stallmain Corporation's latest survey was intended to ------- employee satisfaction in several key categories.
questions.explanation: determine = xác định/đánh giá.

questions.text: Garza's Restaurant is ------- decorated with paintings and photographs of southern Mexico.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ giữa is và decorated → elaborately.

questions.text: Mr. Brighton's first ------- at Glynn Engineering was in the materials testing group.
questions.explanation: first + danh từ → first assignment.

questions.text: The installation of new benches throughout Haverford Park will cost ------- €5,000.
questions.explanation: roughly + số = khoảng/xấp xỉ.

questions.text: ------- who is unable to attend the quarterly stakeholder meeting is welcome to appoint a representative.
questions.explanation: Anyone who = bất cứ ai mà (cấu trúc số ít).

questions.text: Singer Maria Stanley ------- today that she is scheduling a world tour.
questions.explanation: Quá khứ đơn thông báo sự việc đã xảy ra.

questions.text: Biographer Amber Bowen has been recognized for her distinctive writing -------.
questions.explanation: writing style = phong cách viết (danh từ).

questions.text: The award-winning stationery created by the artists at Paperi Designs is of ------- quality.
questions.explanation: exceptional quality = chất lượng xuất sắc.

questions.text: During the past quarter, ------- all of Renafy Technology's sales came from one region.
questions.explanation: nearly all = gần như tất cả.

questions.text: Commercial property insurance covers the ------- associated with repairing or rebuilding a business property after certain events.
questions.explanation: Bảo hiểm chi trả cho expenses (chi phí).

questions.text: The first-aid class usually fills up quickly, so prompt ------- is recommended.
questions.explanation: prompt registration = đăng ký kịp thời.

questions.text: Manufacturing all its products in-house allows Long Bridge Steel Corp. to ------- every aspect of the production process.
questions.explanation: control every aspect = kiểm soát mọi khía cạnh.

questions.text: ------- its use on home-cooking shows, consumer demand for Silvershine Cookware has doubled.
questions.explanation: Because of + cụm danh từ → chỉ nguyên nhân.

questions.text: Artists at Cavin Graphics work ------- with clients through all stages of the design process to ensure satisfaction.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho work → collaboratively.

questions.text: Brile Construction's contract for the mall development project has finally been ------- by the city supervisor.
questions.explanation: Bị động has been + V3 → verified.

questions.text: ------- 4,000 Urlvac trash removal systems are in use in the eastern region.
questions.explanation: Almost + số = gần (xấp xỉ).

questions.text: The conference schedule will be posted online ------- mailed to attendees.
questions.explanation: rather than = thay vì (so sánh hai cách).

questions.text: This ------- has been installed to encourage our passengers to incorporate cycling into their daily lives.
questions.explanation: equipment thay thế cho bicycle racks.

questions.text: Choose the sentence that best fits the passage.

options.text: No additional fee will be charged for bringing a bicycle.
Always make sure to exit at the correct bus stop.
Special lanes for bicycles are now found on most highways.
Some passengers qualify for reduced bus fare.

questions.explanation: Câu sau nhắc đến complimentary program → không thu phí.

questions.text: However, please note that electric bikes are not -------.
questions.explanation: not permitted = không được phép.

questions.text: There you can also learn about great bicycling trails that ------- accessed from our bus routes.
